name: Omo RP1
description: Omo RP1: renders RoboParty's RP1 humanoid, simulated live in MuJoCo by the local sidecar (127.0.0.1:8797), articulated in your world, with !rp1 chat commands handled client-side. Optional Simple Voice Chat plugin streams push-to-talk to a local voice backend you provide (127.0.0.1:8792).
